QuestInfo.name: Maybe This Will Change Your Mind...
QuestInfo.0: Vincent seems happy now that Vicky has a shot at the audition, but there's something amiss...
QuestInfo.1: Vicky wants to bribe the judges for a sure chance at winning. Yup. That definitely sounds like something Triple Volt would do. You decide to help, but only because you still need information on the Spirit of Rock. Bring Vincent 55 Yeti Keychains from the 3rd and 4th floors of the Shopping Center.
QuestInfo.2: Vicky wrapped up the Yeti Keychains for the judges, but something tells you it's not going to be enough.

0.0: Yay!! Now Vicky can be in the audition.
0.1: But that doesn't mean she's definitely going to win. I think we should get something nice for the judges to help sway them.
0.2: There's no such thing as fair play with Triple Volt! Mwahahaha!!
0.3: I've heard that the Spirit of Rock will be at the audition. You can meet the Spirit of Rock when Vicky goes up on stage. So it's in your best interest. Come on... Help me!

yes.0: Great, you're on board! Well, I heard it on the grapevine that one of the judges love Yetis.
yes.1: Good. Get me #b55#k #bYeti Keychains#k. You can get them on the third and fourth floors of the Shopping Center.

no.0: C'mon, we're talking about the Spirit of Rock here!

1.0: Thanks to me, Vicky's definitely gonna win now. Oh man, she's gonna think I'm so cool. SO COOL. Blahhhh I'm so excited ahhhh!!

0.msg: Ahhh this keychain is adorable! Dat fluffy white fur, dose cute black eyes!

1.msg: I dunno. Looks kinda stupid. Like Victor.

2.msg: Did... did you just say stupid?

3.msg: (Maybe they kinda sorta resemble Fort? Though I probably shouldn't tell him that.)

item.0: We can't miss this opportunity! The opportunity for me to capture Vicky's heart... er... I mean... I mean for you to meet the Spirit of Rock! Yes... yes, that's what I meant...
